assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4110 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 16 February 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
